Processing Activity: Example: Deployment of employee monitoring software
Necessity/Proportionality Assessment: Assessed against a documented business need for insider-threat detection; less intrusive alternatives considered and ruled out
Risks to Data Subjects Identified: Risk of excessive monitoring of personal communications and a potential chilling effect on employees
Mitigating Measures: Example: Limit monitoring scope to work accounts only, publish clear employee notice, set a defined data retention limit

Processing Activity: Example: Rollout of a customer analytics platform using behavioral profiling
Necessity/Proportionality Assessment: Assessed against the business need for personalization against the intrusiveness of profiling
Risks to Data Subjects Identified: Risk of inaccurate profiling leading to unfair treatment or excessive inference of sensitive characteristics
Mitigating Measures: Example: Exclude special category data from model inputs, provide an opt-out, run periodic bias review
